entries.title: Psalms 106:1
segments: ¶Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for [he is] good: for his mercy [endureth] for ever. {Praise...: Heb. Hallelujah}

entries.title: Psalms 106:2
segments: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? [who] can shew forth all his praise?

entries.title: Psalms 106:3
segments: Blessed [are] they that keep judgment, [and] he that doeth righteousness at all times.

entries.title: Psalms 106:4
segments: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour [that thou bearest unto] thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

entries.title: Psalms 106:5
segments: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 106:6
segments: ¶We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

entries.title: Psalms 106:7
segments: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked [him] at the sea, [even] at the Red sea.

entries.title: Psalms 106:8
segments: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

words.text: sake, that he might make his mighty power

entries.title: Psalms 106:9
segments: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

words.text: also, and it was dried up

entries.title: Psalms 106:10
segments: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated [them], and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 106:11
segments: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

entries.title: Psalms 106:12
segments: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

entries.title: Psalms 106:13
segments: ¶They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel: {They soon...: Heb. They made haste, they forgat}

words.text: : {They soon...: Heb. They made haste, they forgat}

entries.title: Psalms 106:14
segments: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert. {lusted...: Heb. lusted a lust}

entries.title: Psalms 106:15
segments: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

entries.title: Psalms 106:16
segments: They envied Moses also in the camp, [and] Aaron the saint of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 106:17
segments: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

entries.title: Psalms 106:18
segments: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 106:19
segments: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

entries.title: Psalms 106:20
segments: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

entries.title: Psalms 106:21
segments: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

entries.title: Psalms 106:22
segments: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, [and] terrible things by the Red sea.

entries.title: Psalms 106:23
segments: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy [them].

entries.title: Psalms 106:24
segments: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word: {the pleasant...: Heb. a land of desire}

words.text: : {the pleasant...: Heb. a land of desire}

entries.title: Psalms 106:25
segments: But murmured in their tents, [and] hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 106:26
segments: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness: {to overthrow: Heb. to make them fall}

words.text: : {to overthrow: Heb. to make them fall}

entries.title: Psalms 106:27
segments: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands. {to overthrow: Heb. to make them fall}

words.text: . {to overthrow: Heb. to make them fall}

entries.title: Psalms 106:28
segments: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

entries.title: Psalms 106:29
segments: Thus they provoked [him] to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:30
segments: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and [so] the plague was stayed.

entries.title: Psalms 106:31
segments: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 106:32
segments: They angered [him] also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

entries.title: Psalms 106:33
segments: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

entries.title: Psalms 106:34
segments: ¶They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:

entries.title: Psalms 106:35
segments: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

entries.title: Psalms 106:36
segments: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:37
segments: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

entries.title: Psalms 106:38
segments: And shed innocent blood, [even] the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

entries.title: Psalms 106:39
segments: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

entries.title: Psalms 106:40
segments: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 106:41
segments: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:42
segments: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

words.text: them, and they were brought into subjection

entries.title: Psalms 106:43
segments: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked [him] with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity. {brought...: or, impoverished, or, weakened}

entries.title: Psalms 106:44
segments: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

entries.title: Psalms 106:45
segments: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

entries.title: Psalms 106:46
segments: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

words.text: all those that carried them captives

entries.title: Psalms 106:47
segments: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, [and] to triumph in thy praise.

entries.title: Psalms 106:48
segments: Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD. {Praise...: Heb. Hallelujah}
